verdict.rationale: Clara documents attaching labels (GL codes, cost centers, project IDs) to transactions and a reconciliation flow that categorizes and exports them, plus a marketing claim of automated expense reporting. However, the evidence frames coding as a period-end reconciliation step, not capture at the moment of spend, and it never mentions receipts or memos. Missing for 10: coding at transaction time, receipt capture/attachment, memo fields, merchant-based auto-categorization, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, spend is coded as it happens — merchant, category, memo, receipt — so month-end close is a review, not an archaeology dig

citations.quote: Labels let you attach GL codes, cost centers, or project IDs to transactions
Pull all transactions for a billing period, match them to the billing statement, categorize with labels, and export to your accounting system.
Automated expense reporting, approvals and compliance for full visibility and reduced manual work
